description: Count OpenStreetMap features matching tag filters in an area without returning them. Cheap. Use this before pulling data when the result size is unknown. Give either a point (lat, lon, radius_m) or a bounding box (south, west, north, east).

radius_m.description: Radius in metres, used with lat/lon (default 500)

tags.description: OpenStreetMap tag filters, all must match. Use "*" as the value to match any value, e.g. {"amenity": "cafe"} or {"opening_hours": "*"}.

name: count_features
title: Count matching features
